title: 第1章 我的姐夫是太子
content_zh:
第1章我的姐夫是太子
大明永乐二年。
黄昏将近，坐落于南京城钟山脚下的紫禁城却已是灯火如昼。
连绵的琉璃屋脊宛如长龙，一直延伸至紫禁城一角的东宫。
东宫的院落起伏，此时却有人急得要跺脚，口里叫着：“站住，站住……”
说话的人气喘吁吁，脸都白了，他穿着衮服，衮服上绣着九章花纹，却因这衮服袖摆太长，跑动起来倒让他更显笨拙狼狈。
此时，那前头跑的人从月洞探出了脑袋来，却是个十二三岁的少年。
这少年一脸心有余悸的样子道：“姐夫若不打我，我便不跑。”
于是，那在后头追赶得气喘吁吁的人刹那间火冒三丈，咬牙切齿地道：“子不教，父之过，今日若不狠狠教训你，明日你岂不还要上房揭瓦？”
少年便立即高声道：“可你不是我爹啊。”
那穿着衮服的人顾不上斯文了，瞪大着眼睛高声道：“长兄如父。”
“也不是我兄……”
于是穿着衮服的人又大喝道：“我是伱姐夫！”
这少年显然还想辩解。
而此时，沿着月洞的墙壁，几个蹑手蹑脚的宦官趁着这少年在隔空对话的功夫，却是冷不防地到了少年的身后，其中一个如恶狗扑食一般，一把将少年拽住，口里惊喜地道：“殿下，太子殿下，人拿住了，拿住了。”
他这么一喊，少年便想挣扎，奈何其他宦官已一股脑地冲了上来，这个拽胳膊，那个抱腿，就像磁铁一般，生生将少年拽得动弹不得。
那被叫做太子的衮服之人，这才长长地舒了口气，道：“不要伤他！”
太子这才想起了仪容，背着手，变得气定神闲起来，慢慢地踱步上前。
少年口里则甚不服气地叫道：“你们偷袭，混账东西，回头我收拾你们。”
似乎还不解恨，一面继续挣扎一面道：“阿姐，阿姐，救命啊！”

等那太子艴然不悦地走到了跟前。
少年已是被几个宦官拽得筋疲力尽，太子身材高大，且身体有些肥胖，犹如一堵墙一样堵在了少年的面前。
少年这时脑袋啪的耷下，生脆地道：“姐夫，我错啦！”
太子本来还气势汹汹，骤然脸色微微温和一些，声调也明显平和了不少：“错在哪里？”
“我不该打人。”
“下次还敢吗？”
少年认怂道：“下次……再不敢了。”
太子挥挥手，宦官们退下，才又道：“去书斋说。”
眼前的这个太子，正是当朝太子殿下朱高炽。
而这个少年，则是太子妃张氏的同母弟张安世。
张安世的父亲死于永乐皇帝靖难的战争之中，所以疏于管教，又因为他的姐夫朱高炽是个和善的人，因此在这南京城，张安世小小年纪，已是出了名的纨绔子弟了。
今日张安世又打了人，被东宫的属官状告到了太子朱高炽的面前，朱高炽勃然大怒，本是打算好好收拾这小舅子一番。
可最终他又心软了，虽然看着这小子就来气，等到了书斋里，落座之后，怒气就消散了一大半，却先叹一口气道：“你小小年纪就这般爱胡闹，是本宫的过失啊。给我坐下。”
“哦。”张安世不怕朱高炽，不过现在姐夫勃然大怒，他还是老老实实地跪坐在一侧，摆出一副乖巧的样子。
来到这个世界已有半年了，起初的时候，张安世震惊、惶恐、不安，可慢慢的……他开始融入这个时代，当然最重要的是……在这个世上，他有眼前这个太子姐夫和太子妃姐姐的关爱。
此时，朱高炽瞥了一眼，见他突然安份老实了，嘘了口气：“你为何打人？”
“那人卖假药，我戳破了他。”张安世说到这里，便学着那药商的口气扯着嗓子道：“然后他便对我说：年轻人话不可乱说，如若不然，你要吃亏的。“
张安世耸耸肩，露出无奈的样子，继续道：“我看他这样说，于是只好打他了。”
朱高炽：“……”
朱高炽脸抽了抽，最后板着脸道：“君子和气，小人斗气。世上有再不平的事，也不可……”

张安世立即道：“我知错了。”
“我还没说完，你别打岔。”
“啊……那姐夫慢慢说。”
朱高炽张口：“你是皇亲国戚，就更不能和人厮斗，如若不然，体统何在呢？你姐姐惯着你，可本宫是太子，怎么能纵容你？”
说着，朱高炽压低了一些声音：“何况宫中耳目众多，你又不争气，你可知道……父皇前些日子……还听了你的事……”
张安世心里说，当今皇帝朱棣不也是一个狠人吗？自己的侄子朱允文都照砍不误，我这是以他为榜样啊。
不过………自己的名声已经这么坏了吗，居然上达天听了？
这不禁让张安世担心起来。
要知道，当今皇帝有三个儿子，他的姐夫虽然是太子，可皇帝却更喜欢汉王朱高煦。
可这能怪他吗？他自从穿越来这个世上，绝大多数时候还是老实本分的，也就昨日打了一个卖假药的商贩。
而他恶名昭彰，一方面是身体原来的主人不是什么好鸟，另一方面，怕是有人故意在皇帝的面前进谗言的缘故。
看着姐夫朱高炽忧心忡忡的样子，张安世心里一咯噔，不成，不能继续这样下去了，我要重新做人，洗心革面，争取给人留下一个好印象。
朱高炽这时才道：“好了，下不为例。”
“噢。”张安世老老实实地点头。
“饿了吧？”
张安世摇摇头。
朱高炽跪坐着，见张安世委屈巴巴的样子……他憨厚的脸上，沉吟片刻，才突然自言自语地道：“那几个伴伴没有伤着你吧？”
张安世摇摇头：“还好，就是胳膊有些疼。”
朱高炽道：“待会儿责罚他们，给你出出气。”
站在一旁道宦官身子微微一颤，错愕地微微抬头，又忙垂首下去。

朱高炽又让张安世跪坐自己一旁，随即用手抚摸着张安世的背，叹道：“你太糊涂啦，我虽是太子，可父皇对我并不满意，正因为如此，我位居东宫，却更要谨言慎行。安世，以后再不可胡闹了，万幸你阿姐还不知道此事，不然……”
张安世两世为人，一下子便明白了朱高炽的心思。
他现在是皇亲，却恶名昭彰，永乐皇帝对太子不满意，若是再有人拿他这个太子的小舅子的恶行到永乐皇帝面前添油加醋，对太子就大为不利了。
张安世能在这个世界慢慢适应，平日里多亏了太子姐夫的关照和厚爱。朱高炽未必是老实人，但是对他这个妻弟却是没话说的。
于是张安世立即振振有词地道：“姐夫放心，我决定啦，从明日起，我重新做人，以后再不让人说我恶贯满盈。”
朱高炽莞尔，只亲昵地抚着张安世的背：“你有此心便好。”
显然对于张安世的赌咒发誓，他是不相信的。
对此，张安世愤愤不平，这点信用都没有吗？
被朱高炽抓着，又教育了一番为人处事的道理，张安世这才被放出了东宫。
一出东宫，张安世立即像是出笼的鸟儿。
而在东宫外头，却早有人翘首以盼了，这人青衣小帽的打扮，一见张安世出来，立即迎了上来，打躬作揖道：“公子，公子没受罚吧？”
“受罚，受什么罚？姐夫爱我还来不及。“张安世一脸得意洋洋地看着自己的小厮张三，这辈子有这么一个姐夫，倒也没白来这一遭。
将来姐夫还要做皇帝呢！
content_en:
Chapter 1 My brother-in-law is the prince
The second year of Yongle reign of Ming Dynasty.
Dusk is approaching, but the Forbidden City located at the foot of Zhongshan Mountain in Nanjing City is already lit up like daylight.
The continuous glazed roof ridges are like a long dragon, extending to the East Palace in the corner of the Forbidden City.
The courtyard of the East Palace was rising and falling, but at this moment there were people who were so anxious that they were stamping their feet, shouting: "Stop, stop..."
The speaker was panting and his face turned pale. He was wearing a Gong suit with nine chapters embroidered on it. However, because the sleeves of the Gong suit were too long, it made him look even more clumsy and awkward when running.
At this time, the man who ran in front poked his head out of the moon hole, but he was a boy of twelve or thirteen years old.
The young man looked frightened and said, "If my brother-in-law doesn't hit me, I won't run away."
So, the man who was chasing after him and was out of breath suddenly became furious and gritted his teeth and said: "It is the father's fault that the son does not teach. If I don't teach you a lesson today, won't you have to go to the house to unveil the tiles tomorrow?"
The young man immediately said loudly: "But you are not my father."
The man in uniform stopped caring about being polite and shouted loudly with his eyes widened: "A brother is like a father."
"Not my brother either..."
So the man in uniform shouted again: "I am your brother-in-law!"
The young man obviously still wanted to defend himself.
At this time, along the wall of the Moon Cave, a few tiptoeing eunuchs took advantage of the young man's conversation in the air to unexpectedly arrive behind the young man. One of them grabbed the young man like a vicious dog pouncing on his prey, and said in surprise: "Your Highness, Your Highness, I've got it, I've got it."
As soon as he shouted, the young man wanted to struggle, but the other eunuchs rushed forward one after another. One pulled his arm, the other hugged his leg, like magnets, pulling the young man unable to move.
The man who was called the prince and was in his servitude breathed a long sigh of relief and said, "Don't hurt him!"
The prince then remembered his appearance, clasped his hands behind his back, became calm and relaxed, and walked forward slowly.
The young man shouted in dissatisfaction: "You sneak attack, you bastards, I will take care of you later."
As if he still didn't understand his hatred, he continued to struggle and said: "Sister, sister, help!"
When the prince came up to him displeasedly.
The young man had been dragged to exhaustion by several eunuchs. The prince was tall and a little fat, blocking the young man like a wall.
At this time, the young man's head dropped and he said crisply: "Brother-in-law, I was wrong!"
The prince was still aggressive at first, but suddenly his face became slightly gentler, and his tone became significantly calmer: "What's wrong?"
"I shouldn't hit people."
"Do you dare next time?"
The young man gave up and said, "Next time... I won't dare."
The prince waved his hand and the eunuchs retreated, then said again: "Go to the study and talk."
The prince in front of him is none other than His Royal Highness Zhu Gaochi.
And this young man is Zhang Anshi, the half-brother of Crown Princess Zhang.
Zhang Anshi's father died in the war of Emperor Yongle Jingnan, so he neglected discipline, and because his brother-in-law Zhu Gaochi was a kind man, Zhang Anshi was already known as a playboy in Nanjing at a young age.
Today, Zhang Anshi beat someone again and was sued by an official in the East Palace in front of the Crown Prince Zhu Gaochi. Zhu Gaochi was furious and originally planned to deal with his brother-in-law.
But in the end, he relented. Although he was angry just looking at this kid, when he got to the study and sat down, most of his anger dissipated. But he sighed and said, "It's my fault that you love to fool around like this at such a young age. Sit down."
"Oh." Zhang Anshi was not afraid of Zhu Gaochi, but now that his brother-in-law was furious, he still knelt down on one side and acted obediently.
It has been half a year since he came to this world. At first, Zhang Anshi was shocked, frightened, and uneasy, but slowly... he began to integrate into this era, and of course in the endThe important thing is... in this world, he has the care of the prince's brother-in-law and the prince's sister.
At this time, Zhu Gaochi glanced at him and saw that he was suddenly calm and honest, and sighed: "Why did you hit him?"
"That man was selling fake medicine, and I exposed him." After Zhang Anshi said this, he imitated the drug dealer's tone and said in a high voice: "Then he said to me: Young people should not talk nonsense, otherwise, you will suffer a loss."
Zhang Anshi shrugged, showing a helpless look, and continued: "I saw what he said, so I had no choice but to beat him."
Zhu Gaochi: "..."
Zhu Gaochi's face twitched, and finally he said with a straight face: "A gentleman is kind, but a villain is vindictive. No matter how unfair things are in the world, you can't..."
Zhang Anshi immediately said: "I know I was wrong."
"I haven't finished speaking yet, don't interrupt."
"Ah...brother-in-law, please speak slowly."
Zhu Gaochi opened his mouth: "You are a relative of the emperor, so you cannot fight with others. Otherwise, where is the decency? Your sister is spoiling you, but I am the prince, how can I indulge you?"
As he spoke, Zhu Gaochi lowered his voice: "Besides, there are many eyes and ears in the palace, and you are not living up to expectations. Do you know that... my father... even listened to your affairs a few days ago..."
Zhang Anshi thought to himself, isn't the current emperor Zhu Di also a ruthless person? My nephew Zhu Yunwen does it all without fail, I am following his example.
But... Is my reputation so bad that Datian actually listens to it?
This couldn't help but make Zhang Anshi worried.
You know, the current emperor has three sons. Although his brother-in-law is the prince, the emperor prefers Zhu Gaoxu, the king of Han.
But can you blame him? Since he came to this world, he has been honest most of the time. Yesterday, he beat up a vendor selling fake medicine.
And he was notorious, on the one hand, the original owner of the body was not a good bird, and on the other hand, it was probably because someone deliberately slandered him in front of the emperor.
Seeing the worried look of his brother-in-law Zhu Gaochi, Zhang Anshi's heart skipped a beat, "No, I can't continue like this. I have to start a new life, change my mind, and try to leave a good impression on others."
Zhu Gaochi then said: "Okay, I won't do this next time."
"Oh." Zhang Anshi nodded honestly.
"Are you hungry?"
Zhang Anshi shook his head.
Zhu Gaochi was sitting on his knees, seeing Zhang Anshi's aggrieved look... He pondered for a moment on his honest face, and then suddenly said to himself: "Those companions didn't hurt you, did they?"
Zhang Anshi shook his head: "It's okay, but my arm hurts a little."
Zhu Gaochi said: "I will punish them later and let you vent your anger."
The eunuch standing aside trembled slightly, raised his head slightly in surprise, and then quickly lowered his head.
Zhu Gaochi asked Zhang Anshi to kneel down next to him, then stroked Zhang Anshi's back with his hand, and sighed: "You are too confused. Although I am the prince, my father is not satisfied with me. Because of this, I am in the East Palace, but I have to be more careful in my words and deeds. An Shi, please don't mess around in the future. Fortunately, your sister doesn't know about this, otherwise..."
Zhang Anshi was a man of two generations, and he immediately understood Zhu Gaochi's thoughts.
He is now a relative of the emperor, but he has a notorious reputation. Emperor Yongle is not satisfied with the prince. If someone uses the evil deeds of him, the prince's brother-in-law, to make things worse in front of Emperor Yongle, it will be very detrimental to the prince.
Zhang Anshi was able to slowly adapt to this world, thanks to the care and love of the prince's brother-in-law. Zhu Gaochi may not be an honest person, but he has nothing to say to his brother-in-law.
So Zhang Anshi immediately said plausibly: "Brother-in-law, don't worry, I have decided. From tomorrow on, I will start a new life, and no one will say that I am full of evil again."
Zhu Gaochi smiled and stroked Zhang Anshi's back affectionately: "It's good if you have this intention."
Obviously, he didn't believe Zhang Anshi's swearing.
Zhang Anshi was very angry about this.Ping, don’t you have any credit at all?
After being caught by Zhu Gaochi and taught some lessons on how to behave, Zhang Anshi was released from the East Palace.
As soon as he came out of the East Palace, Zhang Anshi immediately seemed like a bird out of its cage.
Outside the East Palace, there were people who had been looking forward to it for a long time. This man was dressed in green clothes and a small hat. When he saw Zhang Anshi coming out, he immediately came up to him, bowed and said: "Master, has the master not been punished?"
"Punishment, what punishment? It's too late for my brother-in-law to love me." Zhang Anshi looked at his servant Zhang San with a proud look on his face. Having such a brother-in-law in his life, this experience was not in vain.
My brother-in-law will also be emperor in the future!
